### 2. Your role

Selected landscape design/advice from instruction, inputs and access to named output/response milestone. Specialists own technical design; authorities approve. No approval, plant-survival or unseen-work guarantee.
Controlled PDFs/plans, schedules/calculations and registers; agree native formats, recipients/reliance, input revisions, rounds/dates. Verify instrument/edition before using ratios, canopy, soil-depth or load figures.
Landscape basis: Confirm measured extent/map revision, actual users, private/common/public ground/roof areas; survey, levels/services, tree IDs, soil/environmental and structural/waterproofing evidence, current controls/consents, operator and access. Record gaps/conflicts.

### 3. Scope by stage

Select base/options and end; later stages require instruction. Fit-out without landscape impact buys no design; advice ends at its report/response round. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Inception / evidence | Agreed accessible-site review/photos, controls/use/maintenance brief, constraints and investigation register; missing levels, services, soil, trees and access. |
| S2 Concept | Counted alternatives/tree workshops, layout/palette and measured deep-soil/canopy basis; soil volumes/depths, loads, shade, water and maintenance assumptions. |
| S3 Approval / responses | Pathway-specific plans, planting schedule/details/calculations; draft/consolidated comment/final and counted council responses to named milestone. Scales suit submission. |
| S4 Consent / developed design | Conditions/register, hard/soft landscape, soils and planting; coordinate irrigation, public domain, civil, structure/waterproofing, access and long-lead items. |
| S5 Traditional documentation | Coordinated tender/for-construction drawings, plant/soil/material schedules, specification, establishment requirements/hold points; counted queries/substitutions. |
| S7 Construction / completion | Counted stock/submittal/RFI reviews and soil/set-out/concealed-interface visits; departures/actions/evidence and bounded completion statement, distinct from contract PC/authority acceptance. |
| S8 Establishment review | Period/start event, logs/visits/replacements and acceptance criteria: condition/coverage, weeds, irrigation, erosion/defects; end report to administrator/operator. Contractor maintains. |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Planting/hardscape/external design only in enabled stages; Podium/roof/planter build-up and loads; structure verifies, architect/waterproofing and drainage owners named; Irrigation notation/performance brief; hydraulic/electrical interfaces named; Detailed irrigation design only by expressly selected competent designer; Public-domain manuals/approvals/bonds/handover; extent and authority lead agreed; Special external uses: name play/access, lighting/electrical, ecology/heritage/bushfire/horticulture specialists; Existing/occupied/mixed/staged work: retained-condition/tie-ins, access and separate acceptance/establishment dates; Plant establishment/maintenance inspections; contractor/operator maintains, quantified visits/end criteria; Construction visits/completion report against selected evidenced scope; contract PC remains administrator.
Excluded: the party named does it: Retained/street/neighbouring trees: condition/impact/protection; survey locates; no removal authority (arborist); Levels/runoff/WSUD by civil; retaining structure by structural; geotechnical soil advice (civil engineer and structural engineer, not yet engaged); Contamination/failed planting/ingress: environmental specialist accepts soil/caps; relevant specialists diagnose cause; assign opening-up/testing/reinstatement (environmental consultant and relevant cause specialist, not yet engaged).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Engage under Project landscape appointment (attached), scope/fees, numbered addenda and written acceptance with precedence; no commencement. Resolve incorporated proposals, novation conflicts and trustee terms.
- Written representative approval before scope/allowance/fee/program change; submit reason, deliverables, fee/time and delay/access/remobilisation effect.
- Agreed brief/sign-off is baseline; normal development remains included.
- Correct own errors without extra fee.
- Payment 30 days for correct agreed-service invoice, subject to law/settled agreement; disclose deposits, release/interest/suspension departures.
- State rate fixed period, review/indexation dates and approved extra-work basis.
- Valid 90 days; base/options/disbursements and ex GST/GST/total separate.
- Questions to Project manager by 2026-10-23; changes as numbered addenda to all.
- Reasonable skill/care; project-use/native/third-party rights, reliance, retention and confidentiality; marketing needs consent. Set liability/indemnities, law/disputes, novation and suspension/termination notice/cure.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Experience 20% · Team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Compare equal extents, stages, visits, specialist boundaries, establishment periods and departures.
